    for n in nodes_data:

            if field not in n:
                raise ValueError(f"Node missing field '{field}'")
        nodes[n["id"]] = dict(n)  # copy to avoid mutation
    
    # Build children map
    children = {nid: [] for nid in nodes}
    for nid, n in nodes.items():
        parent = n["parent"]
        if parent is not None:
            if parent not in nodes:
                raise ValueError(f"Node '{nid}' has unknown parent '{parent}'")
            children[parent].append(nid)
    
    # Find root
    root_nodes = [nid for nid, n in nodes.items() if n["parent"] is None]
    if len(root_nodes) != 1:
        raise ValueError(f"Expected exactly one root node, found {len(root_nodes)}")
    
    required_symbols_set = set(required_symbols)
    
    # Track which nodes are currently retained
    retained = set(nodes.keys())
    
    # Get current symbol coverage

    # Sort nodes by depth descending, then by node ID ascending (stable tie-break)

    removal_order = []

        # Check symbol not in required_symbols

            continue
        
        # Check no retained children

        if retained_children:

        if not required_symbols_set.issubset(remaining_symbols):

        removal_order.append(nid)
    
    retained_ids = sorted(retained)
    
    return {
        "retained_ids": retained_ids,
        "removal_order": removal_order
    }
